abilities.description: After assigning all your stats, add +1 to Edge.

Underwater breathing: You do not have to make preparations to go underwater, you breathe underwater freely, and filter out most toxins in the water if they are present, and whenever you are underwater fighting against a foe that does not breathe underwater, you are ALWAYS in control. Always take +1 to any rolls while swimming. When speaking with another Nautolan, take +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.13b2d777c6fb719d]{Gather Information} to tell if they’re lying, and take +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.287bb4c2b53ea847]{Forge a Bond} with them.
